items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I'd been used to playing Don Redmon's music... I used to practice with him and I learned a lot from Mr. Redmon

ctx.x: And then McKinney didn't play anymore? He just managed?

No, he was just the manager. And as the story goes with that band, they used to go up to Manitou Beach, Michigan, every summer to [Clark's Lake] and play. When Jean Goldkette Gene Galkit heard the band up there he liked what he heard, so he was getting ready to build this million dollar ballroom called the Graystone in Detroit. So he liked the band, so he figured with himself that he could do something with this band, so he sent and got Don Redmon to come, and Don Redmon at that time was playing with Fletcher…
